claims.claim: promptarena validate and promptarena export use packc/compiler
compiler.Check stages pack_id, load, compile, skills, workflow, compositions, agents, governance, pack, pack_schema; early stages stop, later collect all
compile prints warnings as '⚠ [stage] message' and fails with 'Compilation failed:'
arena config, prompt configs and tool files are schema-validated on load; arena config requires providers and defaults
each prompt gets the default template/provider/validator pipeline
a tool file that fails to load fails the compile
skill directory paths are made relative to the config directory
packc compile sets name=id, version v1.0.0, description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
default id from current directory name via SanitizePackID; non-letter start gets pack- prefix
pack_metadata wins over spec.metadata with a warning; otherwise first spec.metadata by prompt_configs id is promoted with a warning
missing media example files warn 'media(<task>): Media file not found: ...' relative to config dir (compile) or prompt dir (compile-prompt)
compiled fragments map holds {{name}} placeholders, not fragment content
templates are not parsed; only check is variables declared when template contains {{
compile-prompt: id from task type (_ to -), name/version/description from prompt, no $schema
two compiles of the same inputs differ only in compilation.created_at (RFC3339 seconds); template_engine picked from map-ordered prompts
go install/source builds report version 'dev' (packc dev, compiled_with packc-dev); release builds set main.version
